Default-tier bootstrap overflow (FA-iOS incident, 2026-05-05) had TWO stacked causes, not one: (1) project resolution silently failing → scope:auto writes fell through to the user's GLOBAL store; (2) write-amplification (same key 4-7× per session, see [[context.writeAmpPattern]]) inflated bytes faster than entry count suggested. Bootstrap grew 16K→68K over 8 days while the "[project: NONE]" banner sat visible but ignored (informational only — agents didn't act on it).

FIXES SHIPPED in v1.14: refuse reverie_set on project:null without explicit scope (#99, PR #104); 3rd-same-key-write-in-30min warning (#101, PR #108); reverie_context size-budget shedding caps the response (#100, PR #108).

Deep dive: docs/investigation-bootstrap-overflow-2026-05-05.md + docs/dataset-2026-05-05-findings.md.
